title: Finance Assistant
description:
Location: Hemel Hempstead

Duration: Temporary assignment

Salary: Competitive, depending on experience

We are looking for an experienced Finance Administrator / Finance Assistant to join a business on a temporary basis and support a finance clean up project.

The main focus of the role will be reviewing and tidying up the organisation's banking information, making sure users, approvers and account details are accurate and up to date.

Key responsibilities:
- Review existing bank accounts and banking records
- Identify and remove outdated users and approvers
- Update authorised users and approval details where required
- Review who is connected to each account and ensure records are accurate
- Help bring banking information and processes up to date
- Work through historic information and identify any discrepancies or gaps
- Maintain clear and accurate records throughout the project
- Support the wider finance team with general finance administration as required
- Produce and work with Excel spreadsheets to analyse and organise information

About you:

We are looking for someone who is hands on, organised and very comfortable working with financial data.

You will need:
- Previous experience within a finance administration or finance assistant role
- Good understanding of banking processes and finance systems
- Strong Excel skills and confidence working with spreadsheets
- Excellent attention to detail
- A methodical approach to working through large amounts of information
- The ability to work independently and take ownership of a project
- Good communication skills and the confidence to liaise with internal teams and banking contacts where required
